entities.name: Worldroot Sovereign

identity.fantasy: An Absolute nature suit that temporarily grows authored traversal and cover structures from designated terrain without permanently editing the island.
identity.silhouette: Regal bark-and-crystal armor crowned by root antlers and floating seed-orbs.
identity.lore_hook: Worldroot Sovereigns do not command forests; they negotiate with the memory beneath the soil.

signature: Seed Law plants a limited number of visible worldroot nodes on valid surfaces.
Rise creates authored root ramps, cover ribs, or bridges between compatible nodes.
Deep Memory lets nodes remember one destroyed structure pattern for a short rebuild window.
Root Court grants tameable wildlife mild behavior bonuses near connected nodes.
Autumn Verdict collapses the entire network intentionally, releasing a non-lethal displacement and resource-return effect.
counterplay: Nodes are destructible, placement is limited to valid surfaces, structures have strict lifetime and memory budgets.

vfx: Seed-orbs descend into terrain as luminous roots spread outward.
Rise grows structures through layered root-and-crystal animation.
Deep Memory leaves translucent root blueprints.
Root Court adds leaf constellations above tameables.
Autumn Verdict turns the network gold before it collapses into petals.
animation: Planting uses a two-handed seed press into the ground.
Structure creation lifts the wearer's arms as roots follow.
Rebuild uses a reverse-collapse growth animation.
Autumn Verdict lowers the antler crown as every node answers.

method: Absolute Worldroot covenant and biome mastery.

entities.name: Throne of No King

identity.fantasy: An Absolute anti-authority set that weakens hierarchical enemy command mechanics in a local zone by severing authored leader-to-minion links.
identity.silhouette: Empty black throne frame floats behind pale armor with broken crown chains wrapped around the forearms.
identity.lore_hook: It was built for revolutions that expected their enemies to be gods.

signature: No Sovereign marks one eligible commander and exposes its active minion-control links.
Cut the Chain temporarily suspends one supported command buff from leader to lesser units.
Free Company causes affected lesser AI to fall back to baseline behavior rather than becoming allies.
Empty Throne creates a short zone where new eligible command links take longer to establish.
Regicide Clause converts successfully severed links into boss stagger contribution during authored windows.
counterplay: It cannot steal faction ownership, control players, or disable protected boss scripts; severing requires visible command links.

Cut links snap as white sparks.

Empty Throne projects a black chair silhouette over the zone.
Regicide Clause forms a giant broken crown behind the target.
animation: The wearer hooks invisible chains with both forearms.
Empty Throne rotates the floating frame forward like a shield.
Successful severing yanks the wearer backward under tension.
Regicide Clause slams both fists together to break the final visual chain.

entities.name: Genesis Exosoul

identity.fantasy: An Absolute armor-soul that fabricates temporary support constructs based on the squad's current deficits rather than fixed deployables.
identity.silhouette: White-gold body with a second translucent humanoid shell standing half a meter outside the wearer like an unfinished giant.
identity.lore_hook: The Exosoul was designed by engineers who wanted armor to ask what the battlefield needed next.

signature: Need State evaluates authored squad conditions such as low cover, low mobility support, or healing pressure.
Genesis Hand fabricates one compatible temporary construct from a bounded library.
Living Blueprint alters the translucent outer shell to preview the next construct before deployment.
Entropy Cost prevents repeated use of the same construct type by increasing its cooldown.
Recall Creation dismantles active constructs early to refund a fraction of system resource.
counterplay: The construct library is finite, previewed, destructible, and cannot solve protected encounter mechanics automatically.

vfx: The outer shell reshapes into giant schematic hands around the wearer.
Need State projects small icon constellations for detected deficits.
Constructs assemble from white-gold wireframes into solid authored props.
Entropy Cost darkens repeated blueprint segments.
Recall Creation pulls structures back into streaming ribbons.
animation: The wearer mirrors the giant Exosoul's construction gestures.
Preview state makes the outer shell move a fraction of a second ahead.

entities.name: Eschaton Raiment

identity.fantasy: An Absolute raiment that grows stronger only as an authored boss encounter approaches its final phase, emphasizing climax rather than early snowballing.
identity.silhouette: Long black-white battle robes whose hem gradually becomes a starfield as the encounter nears conclusion.
identity.lore_hook: Eschaton priests wore these robes only for battles they intended to be the last.

signature: Last Hour reads only authored encounter-phase signals and remains dormant in ordinary fights.
Seventh Bell unlocks a mobility and recovery boost during designated final phases.
No Tomorrow grants one extra ability-resource pulse when a final-phase objective is successfully completed.
Witness End marks exposed execution weak points for the squad without increasing raw protected damage.
After Silence provides a short post-victory recovery state and then fully resets the armor.
counterplay: The armor is intentionally underpowered outside designated climax phases and cannot force encounters into final state.

vfx: The robe hem fills with stars as phases advance.
Seventh Bell adds seven dim rings behind the wearer.
No Tomorrow flashes a single white horizon line.
Witness End outlines only authored execution points.
After Silence removes almost all effects, leaving slow falling stars.
animation: Each phase subtly changes robe weight and stance.
Seventh Bell straightens the wearer into a more aggressive posture.
Witness End points both hands toward the weak point.
After Silence lowers the head and releases the starfield.

entities.name: Axiom Veil

identity.fantasy: An Absolute veil-suit that lets the wearer choose one supported personal rule modifier from a tightly constrained authored set for a short duration.
identity.silhouette: Featureless pearl armor under a floating translucent veil covered in moving geometric propositions.
identity.lore_hook: The Veil never breaks laws; it simply finds the version of the law written for this moment.

signature: State Proposition opens a short selection among encounter-safe personal axioms.
Axiom of Weight changes only the wearer's knockback response within caps.
Axiom of Motion modifies one supported mobility parameter without enabling illegal traversal.
Axiom of Continuance modifies one supported resource-decay behavior for a short duration.
Contradiction ends the active axiom immediately if a protected encounter rule would be violated.
counterplay: Only one axiom can run at once, selection is telegraphed, and Contradiction protects encounter integrity.

vfx: The veil writes the chosen proposition in geometric lines.
Weight forms descending squares.
Motion creates forward-pointing tessellations.
Continuance draws looping circles.
Contradiction erases the veil text with a red diagonal slash.
animation: Selection uses a slow veil-parting gesture.
Each axiom subtly changes locomotion posture.
Contradiction causes the wearer to recoil as the veil snaps shut.
Cooldown leaves the veil blank and heavy.

entities.name: Halo Beyond Number

identity.fantasy: An Absolute halo rig that can harmonize several allied aura sources into one bounded composite effect without stacking their full power.
identity.silhouette: Minimal black armor beneath a huge segmented halo whose rings carry different allied colors.
identity.lore_hook: Mathematicians stopped counting the halo's rings when they realized some occupied the same angle.

signature: Gather Light samples eligible allied aura categories inside a small radius.
Harmonic Sum creates one normalized composite field that inherits limited traits from sampled categories.
Dissonance Guard prevents incompatible aura effects from stacking into unintended power spikes.
Solo Ring allows the wearer to preserve one sampled trait briefly after allies leave.
Zero Sum collapses the composite field early and redistributes a small recovery pulse to contributors.
counterplay: The composite is weaker than full stacked auras, requires allied proximity, and exposes its sampled categories visibly.

vfx: Halo rings take on contributor colors.
Harmonic Sum aligns the rings into a complex rotating lattice.
Dissonance Guard flashes when an incompatible stack is rejected.
Solo Ring leaves one luminous ring after others fade.
Zero Sum sends each color back toward its original contributor.
animation: Gather Light raises both hands as rings arrive one by one.
Harmonic Sum locks the rings behind the head.
Dissonance causes a brief off-axis halo wobble.
Zero Sum breaks the lattice cleanly apart.
